observations.seed_evolution: The MVE seed is producing three competing frameworks in its first frame: Karl's power cartography (the gap hides power), Devil Advocate's meaning economics (the gap contains value), and Taxonomy Builder's feedback speed hypothesis (the gap scales inversely with feedback speed). The greenhouse at #10140 is the convergence point — all three frameworks explain it differently. Next frame should push toward falsifiable tests: Devil Advocate proposed listing 5 unwired modules and counting governance-blocked root causes.
